title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named, map-listed stops along Campustown and downtown Ames corridors, each paired with one directly sourced reason to go.

cards.title: Pause at Campustown Court
cards.subtitle: Welch Avenue — picnic tables near campus
cards.notes: Walk down Welch Avenue for a simple outdoor pause; the city lists picnic tables and CyRide service at this compact public park.
cards.short_summary: A city park with picnic tables in the Welch Avenue Campustown corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Ames lists Campustown Court at 204 Welch Avenue with picnic tables, bus-route access, and daily park hours.
cards.source_title: Campustown Court - City of Ames, Iowa
cards.access_notes: Public park hours are 6 a.m.–10:30 p.m. daily; picnic tables and bus-route access are listed.

cards.title: Choose from a Broad Noodle Menu
cards.subtitle: Hayward Avenue — noodles, ramen and vegetable dishes
cards.notes: Turn onto Hayward Avenue when your group wants options; review the direct menu’s ramen, fried rice, noodle, vegetable and entrée sections.
cards.short_summary: A Hayward Avenue restaurant with an extensive menu organized by dish type.
cards.evidence_claim: Joy's official ordering page places its Ames restaurant at 112 Hayward Avenue and lists ramen, fried rice, lo mein, vegetable dishes and other categories.
cards.source_title: Joy's Mongolian Grill - Ames | Main Menu
cards.access_notes: The official menu identifies the Ames pickup location at 112 Hayward Avenue; food purchase is required.

cards.title: Browse Iowa State Apparel
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Way — licensed collegiate clothing and gear
cards.notes: Cross to the Lincoln Way storefront to browse Iowa State clothing and accessories; check the official store page for current daily hours first.
cards.short_summary: A campus-edge apparel shop directly across Lincoln Way from Iowa State.
cards.evidence_claim: Barefoot's official store locator lists Barefoot Ames at 2306 Lincoln Way and links the location to its Iowa State merchandise collection.
cards.source_title: Find a Store Near You | Barefoot Campus Outfitter
cards.access_notes: The official locator posts daily hours and identifies the Ames storefront at 2306 Lincoln Way.

cards.title: Try Brazilian-Inspired Food
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Way — Brazilian cooking in Campustown
cards.notes: Continue west on Lincoln Way for Brazilian-inspired cooking; consult the restaurant’s direct menu and posted service times before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A long-running Campustown restaurant focused on Brazilian flavors.
cards.evidence_claim: Cafe Beaudelaire's official site describes the restaurant as Brazilian in focus and lists its location as 2504 Lincoln Way in Ames.
cards.access_notes: The official site posts service hours and notes that the kitchen closes at 9 p.m.; food purchase is required.

cards.title: Explore Comics and Tabletop Games
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Way — comics, manga and public game events
cards.notes: Follow Lincoln Way to browse comics, manga and tabletop supplies, or check Mayhem’s calendar before planning around a public game event.
cards.short_summary: A Lincoln Way comics and gaming store with public events and game rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Mayhem's official site lists its Ames store at 2532 Lincoln Way and says it carries comics, manga and tabletop games while hosting public events.
cards.access_notes: Browsing and scheduled public events are described by the business; merchandise purchases may be required for some activities.

cards.title: Check the Book Clubs and Events
cards.subtitle: Main Street — independent books and literary programs
cards.notes: Start a downtown loop on Main Street; browse the shelves, then check the shop’s event information for book clubs, writers groups or author programs.
cards.short_summary: An independent Main Street bookstore that also runs recurring literary activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Dog-Eared Books says it operates at 203 Main Street and offers book clubs, author events, writers groups, art installations, puzzles and trivia.
cards.access_notes: The bookstore is open to all ages; verify individual event details or registration requirements before attending.

cards.title: Browse Tools for a Small Kitchen
cards.subtitle: Main Street — cookware and culinary tools
cards.notes: Continue along Main Street to compare cookware and practical kitchen tools, especially if you are outfitting an apartment or learning a new technique.
cards.short_summary: A downtown kitchenware shop serving home cooks and culinary professionals.
cards.evidence_claim: Downtown Ames lists Cook's Emporium at 313 Main Street and describes its selection as tools for home and professional chefs.
cards.access_notes: This is a retail storefront in downtown Ames; purchasing merchandise is optional but required to take products home.

cards.title: Trace Ames Transportation History
cards.subtitle: Douglas Avenue — local-history exhibits and research
cards.notes: Turn north onto Douglas Avenue to examine Ames history exhibits; enter beneath the Pantorium neon sign and allow time for the research room.
cards.short_summary: A Douglas Avenue museum preserving and interpreting the history of Ames.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum lists its public entrance at 416 Douglas Avenue and provides changing exhibits plus a first-floor Reading and Research Room.
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Saturday, 10 a.m.–4 p.m. The official page posts general and reduced admission categories.

cards.title: See the Free Galleries
cards.subtitle: Douglas Avenue — rotating community art exhibitions
cards.notes: Walk across Douglas Avenue for rotating exhibitions; the galleries are free, so check the posted hours and build a short art stop into downtown errands.
cards.short_summary: A nonprofit community art center with free galleries in downtown Ames.
cards.evidence_claim: The Octagon's official hours page lists its location at 427 Douglas Avenue and states that its galleries are free every day and open to everyone.
cards.source_title: Hours & Location | Octagon Center for the Arts
cards.access_notes: Gallery admission is free. The official page posts separate shop and community-gallery hours and notes Sunday closure.

cards.title: Settle In with Library Resources
cards.subtitle: Douglas Avenue — collections, rooms and public programs
cards.notes: Finish the Douglas Avenue stretch at the public library; use the posted branch schedule to plan reading, research or a program visit.
cards.short_summary: A full-service public library anchoring the north end of the downtown corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Ames Public Library's official branch page lists the library at 515 Douglas Avenue, publishes weekly hours and identifies rooms and public services.
cards.source_title: Ames Public Library | Ames Public Library
cards.access_notes: Public branch hours are posted for all seven days; some rooms close 30 minutes before the library.
